newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 3.682 billion yuan from 3.553 billion on Thursday and the most active one was the seven-day contract.
Traders said the sharp rebound in the domestic A share market seemed to be an important factor in Friday's increased in turnover.
Shanghai's A share index rose 4.22 percent to 1,222.436 points on turnover of 8.4 billion yuan on Friday.
Some speculators encouraged by the strong A shares were seen on the interbank market while non-banking financial institutions remained the major buyers, traders said.
"The rates will be supported in the next few days by two more new A share issues," a trader said.
